item.statement: Interface, algorithm, numerical, and memory planes must cohere: i32 shifts are added in representable arithmetic, floor-modulo maps to logical bounds, f32 values are copied without arithmetic, and pitch strides storage without affecting logical geometry.

plans.objective: Exercise cross-plane consistency at wrap boundaries and with pitch greater than width.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the cases on Ascend 950PR, and capture logical and padding output.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff logical cells match the floor-mod oracle bitwise, padding remains unchanged, and no out-of-bounds access or overflow is reported for representable sums.
plans.setup: Run boundary cases (shiftX and shiftY in {-width,-1,0,width-1,width,width+1}) with pitch=width+5, and pre-fill padding with sentinels; compute host oracle for logical cells.
